messages:
Jules (CSM): Kicking off Lumenix onboarding. Goal: get them to GA in 60 days with Dedicated capacity and SSO. Please confirm owners for tech lead, product integration, enablement, and legal/compliance checks. Meeting Wed 10am PT. Quick asks in thread: primary success metric, required integrations, and biggest risks.

Asha Patel: I can own the infra/runbook + validation tests. Will pull current infra diagram and list of required endpoints.

Ben Kim: I'll own product integration and acceptance criteria. Primary metric proposal: 95th pctl latency <250ms for text-gen at their typical batch size; cost per 1k tokens target TBD after quantization. Need SSO (SAML) + VPC peering.

Marcus Li: I'll run enablement and adoption. Plan: two 90-min workshops (dev + product), sandbox for 1 week with seed prompts, and a playbook for success. Also want to schedule a customer-facing demo + Q&A after initial integration.

Sam Ortiz: Heads-up on renewal risk: their PO indicates auto-renew at day 90 unless product OKs. We need a short, measurable success rubric to protect renewal. Suggest 3 checks: latency SLA, successful SSO login by devs, and a sample eval showing no regression vs baseline.

OnboardBot: Added meeting to calendar and created initial docs: https://docs.internal/redwood/onboard/lumenix (internal).

Jules (CSM): Great. Can each owner post a 3-bullet owner plan by EOD tomorrow? Put blockers inline so we can triage.

Asha Patel: Will do. Initial infra checklist:
```
- Verify model variant and quantization plan
- VPC/networking + NAT/egress rules
- Secrets/KMS access and audit log forwarding
```
Main potential blocker: Lumenix needs private registry access (we need legal to sign NDA for their registry token).

Ben Kim: Product acceptance items:
- End-to-end request flow (client -> Redwood -> model -> client) working in sandbox
- Feature flags for canary rollout + fallback model
- Tracing integrated with Console for first 10 routes

Marcus Li: For enablement, I want a single-sheet quickstart + a recorded walkthrough. Also ask: can we provision a mock dataset so prompt tuning tests can run?

Sam Ortiz: I'll reach out to Renewals team to flag the timeline and attach the rubric. We should capture customer sentiment weekly — propose a 1-question weekly pulse (satisfaction + blockers) and a short prompt-eval every 2 weeks to track quality drift.

Jules (CSM): Good call. Owner assignments so far: Asha (infra), Ben (product integration & acceptance), Marcus (enablement), Sam (renewal/risk). I'll pull legal and infra-security into the Wed call.

Asha Patel: Small ask: who owns IDP mapping? We need attributes from their IdP (email, team, role) to wire SAML. If someone can intro the identity contact on the customer side that'd speed things up.

Ben Kim: I'll ask for the IdP contact in the intro email. Also double-checking data residency — Lumenix asked for EU-only data processing for logs. We need to confirm their region and if Private deployment is required.

Marcus Li: For feedback capture, my plan: weekly pulse + post-training survey + a shared Miro board for feature requests. I'll draft the surveys and share with the team.

Sam Ortiz: Noted blockers so far: NDA for registry, IdP contact, EU-data residency confirmation, and sandbox dataset. Those map directly to renewal risk if unresolved by day 30.

Jules (CSM): Perfect. Action items: everyone drop 3-bullet owner plan by EOD tomorrow; Ben to request IdP contact & data residency; Asha to start infra runbook and flag legal NDA; Marcus to prep enablement plan; Sam to notify Renewals and create the 90d rubric. See you Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:
